app.title: RAGNAROCK EDITOR
app.subtitle: Rhythm map editor for Ragnarock · Meta Quest
intro.title: WELCOME, VIKING!
intro.body:
This editor turns your drumming into a playable Ragnarock map.

1. Pick a track from your headset.
2. Check the detected BPM.
3. Hit the four drums with your hammers in time.
4. Preview the runes and export the map.

Stand in the middle of the deck: the drums are always in front of you. Point a controller at a button and press the trigger.
